name: OSS_DETERMINANT_CHARGE_RULES
description: This table is used to capture determinant volume pricing charge rule.

columns.name: DETERMINANT_CHARGE_RULE_ID
columns.description: This field uniquely identifies the specific determinant charge rule associated with each row in the dataset.

columns.name: DETERMINANT_CHARGE_RULE_PUID
columns.description: This field acts as an alternative identifier for the determinant charge rule associated with the row.

columns.name: CHARGE_DETERMINANT_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the charge determinant id associated with the current rule.

columns.name: DYNAMIC_MATRIX_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the dynamic matrix id associated with the current rule.

columns.name: DYNAMIC_MATRIX_NAME
columns.description: This field tracks the dynamic matrix name associated with the current rule.

columns.name: DYNAMIC_MATRIX_CLASS_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the dynamic matrix class id associated with the current rule.

columns.name: MATRIX_CLASS_GUID
columns.description: This field tracks the matrix class guid associated with the current rule.

columns.name: HASH_KEY
columns.description: This field tracks identifier for balance criteria predicate hash value combination.

columns.name: HASH_VALUE
columns.description: This field tracks balance criteria predicate hash value combination.

columns.name: RULE_PRECEDENCE
columns.description: This field tracks the precedence with which rules need to be considered while pricing.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the source object id associated with the current rule.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: This field tracks the source object code associated with the current rule.

columns.name: RULE_SOURCE_TYPE
columns.description: This field tracks the rule source type associated with the current rule.

columns.name: MASTER_CRITERIA_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the master criteria id associated with the current rule.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
